reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and anyone can print that; I look for NSF or USP, and there are no reviews yet. I read reviews for 20 minutes before trying anything new, and I already have a magnesium on Subscribe & Save that I won't swap for an unproven brand.
objection: No NSF or USP seal and zero reviews, so "lab-tested" is only the brand's own claim. At $1 a day for 200 mg I'd be paying a premium for a box I can't verify.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few dozen verified reviews from people who took it for a few months.
